dues.heading: Village Dues
dues.fallback: As a resident, you'll pay Village Dues that cover utilities, maintenance, and community services. Together, we work to reduce costs and create surplus that benefits everyone.

hero.intro: The Resident Space is for those coordinating the success of the whole Village from the perspective of Residents. Find your place in a loving community where all beings belong and thrive.
hero.headline: Make {village} Home

steps.intro: Each step helps both sides decide. You figure out if {village} is right for you; we figure out the same.

items.title: Attend Community Call
items.description: Learn about the basics and ask any immediate questions about living at {village}.

items.title: Attend Community Events
items.bullet2: Land tours with the founding team
items.description: Join potlucks, land tours, and community gatherings to experience {village}'s living culture.

items.title: Become a Founding Seeder
items.bullet2: First access to homes and land
items.description: Join the Founding Seeders, our waitlist of soul-aligned people securing first access to homes and land at {village}. This is how you raise your hand and say: I'm serious about this.

items.title: Community Training
items.bullet1: Do the training, or show you already live it
items.description: Either complete our training in NVC (Nonviolent Communication), authentic relating, and other community practices, or demonstrate you already know and live these essential practices.

items.title: Sign the {commitment} / Formal Membership
items.description: Become an official member of the community by signing the membership agreement.

items.title: Explore Housing Options
items.description: Browse available lots and housing options to find your perfect spot in the village.

items.title: Put Down a Deposit on Your Future Home
items.description: Secure your future home with a fully refundable deposit{range}. This holds your place and starts the real conversation.

items.title: Background Check
items.description: Once your deposit is down, we complete a background check together. It's part of our commitment to community safety{background-note}.

items.title: Fireside Dinner With the Founding Team
items.bullet2: In person on the land, or online
items.bullet3: A friendship ritual, not an interview
items.description: You're invited to an intimate 1-on-1 fireside dinner with the founding team, in person on the land, or online if you can't make it. A casual, beautiful friendship ritual where both sides explore the commitment fully.

items.title: Children's Play Day
items.description: If you have children, attend our family day to see how kids thrive in our community.

items.title: Resident Right of Passage
items.description: Complete the passage with a vote from current residents. Review the Good Neighbor criteria.

items.title: Purchase Land Share Agreement
items.description: Secure your land with a Land Share Agreement and required Land Credits.

items.title: Build Your Home
items.description: Work with our approved builders or bring your own plans. Observe Resident Governance.

items.title: Move In Celebration!
items.description: Welcome home! Celebrate with the {village} Family and begin your life in the village.

steps.heading: Your Path to Residency

rights.body: As a resident you are a co-owner of this village, not a tenant. Read the full covenant that protects you and defines what we're building together.
rights.heading: Your Rights and Responsibilities

tenure.body: Your Land Share Agreement gives you long-term access to your land with the ability to renew and pass down to your children{transfer-note}. The structure holds ownership in the community and gives your family security.
tenure.heading: Land Share Agreements

titles.body: {village} marks long presence with a title. These titles are honorary: they carry no voice in governance and no rights today. Voice comes from what you contribute, and a village may decide later to attach powers of its own to these titles.

items.description: Your arrival, you've made the village your home
Deep roots, steward of community traditions
Village wisdom keeper, mentor to new residents
Intergenerational bridge, keeper of the village's longest memory

titles.heading: Titles for Time Here

closing.body: Start with a community call to learn about life at {village}, then explore our housing options and available lots.
closing.heading: Find Your Home

nextStep.body: Schedule a village visit to experience {village} firsthand and ask any questions about becoming a resident.
nextStep.heading: Your Next Step
